correctness.rationale: On X=N∪{∞} with isolated naturals and cofinite neighborhoods of ∞, omega(A) is {∞} iff A contains infinitely many natural numbers; otherwise empty. All modal subformulas vanish at isolated points. For k atoms, m=2^k isolated truth types, the isolated propositional skeleton b_phi(t) and at-limit function F_phi(a,I), with a the valuation type at ∞ and nonempty I the set of types recurring infinitely often, determine formula truth under every valuation. Structural induction gives F_{◇ψ}(a,I)=1 iff I intersects {t:b_ψ(t)=1}. Conversely all (a,I) are realized by independent limit value and periodic isolated tail, and any isolated t can be inserted finitely. The depth-one generators χ_t and ◇χ_t identify each I; δ=◇top singles out ∞. Boolean combinations therefore realize arbitrary independent functions b on m isolated types and F on m(2^m−1) limit coordinates. Hence the complete finite-variable Boolean algebra has m2^m independent atoms and exactly 2^(m2^m) classes. At k=0 the isolated and limit points are distinguished by ◇top, proving depth one sharp; formulas of depth0 cannot. Explicit log2 class counts for k=0,1,2 are 2,8,64, i.e. class counts 4,256,2^64. Source checker inspected; its 1680 trials only corroborate induction.
